author: Thomas à Kempis
title: That we must give ourselves to humble works when we are unequal to those that are lofty

verses.text: “My Son, thou art not always able to continue in very fervent desire after virtues, nor to stand fast in the loftier region of contemplation; but thou must of necessity sometimes descend to lower things because of thine original corruption, and bear about the burden of corruptible life, though unwillingly and with weariness.
verses.modernizedText: “My Son, you cannot always continue in very fervent desire for virtues or stand firm in the loftier region of contemplation; because of your original corruption you must sometimes descend to lower things and bear the burden of corruptible life, though unwillingly and with weariness.

verses.text: So long as thou wearest a mortal body, thou shalt feel weariness and heaviness of heart.
verses.modernizedText: As long as you wear a mortal body, you will feel weariness and heaviness of heart.

verses.text: Therefore thou oughtest to groan often in the flesh because of the burden of the flesh, inasmuch as thou canst not give thyself to spiritual studies and divine contemplation unceasingly.
verses.modernizedText: Therefore you ought often to groan in the flesh because of the burden of the flesh, since you cannot give yourself unceasingly to spiritual study and divine contemplation.

verses.text: “At such a time it is expedient for thee to flee to humble and external works, and to renew thyself with good actions; to wait for My coming and heavenly visitation with sure confidence; to bear thy exile and drought of mind with patience, until thou be visited by Me again, and be freed from all anxieties.
verses.modernizedText: “At such a time it is helpful for you to turn to humble and outward works and renew yourself with good actions; to wait with sure confidence for My coming and heavenly visitation; and to bear your exile and dryness of mind patiently until I visit you again and you are freed from all anxieties.

verses.text: For I will cause thee to forget thy labours, and altogether to enjoy eternal peace.
verses.modernizedText: For I will cause you to forget your labors and fully enjoy eternal peace.

verses.text: I will spread open before thee the pleasant pastures of the Scriptures, that with enlarged heart thou mayest begin to run in the way of My commandments.
verses.modernizedText: I will spread open before you the pleasant pastures of the Scriptures, so that with an enlarged heart you may begin to run in the way of My commandments.

verses.text: And thou shalt say, ‘The sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.’”(1)
verses.modernizedText: And you will say, ‘The sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.’”(1)
